name: Agent CA Notification Status Advice V 04
definition: Scope|This message is sent by a CSD to an issuer (or its agent) to report the status, or change in status, of a notification advice or notification cancellation request.|Usage|When this message is used to report the status of a notification advice then the building block Agent Corporate Action Notification Advice Identification must be present.|When this message is used to provide the status of a notification cancellation request then the building block Notification Cancellation Request Identification must be present.

AgentDocumentIdentificationAndStatus.name: Agent Document Identification And Status
AgentDocumentIdentificationAndStatus.definition: Identification and status of the linked document (ie. corporate action notification advice or notification cancellation request) sent by the agent.

CorporateActionGeneralInformation.name: Corporate Action General Information
CorporateActionGeneralInformation.definition: General information about the corporate action event.
